dek: Three clocks. Main STATUS publishes v15.44/v15.45 and keeps the v15.03 obstruction. v15.98–v16.55 are research branches, not merged to main. The 10 Oct overlapping-guard tip is scoped C3, not a general no-go and not numbered v16. Not a source. Not Einstein.
text:
1) Main STATUS.md is a publication note for v15.44 and v15.45. It does not erase the v15.03 obstruction; that file is kept as HISTORICAL_STATUS_v15.03.md. Source correspondence NOT_EVALUATED. Pillar 3 OPEN. 2) v15.75 through v15.97 are research-branch publications. None is merged. v15.78–v15.97 is one line of separate verdicts, including scientific NOs. v15.88 applies a 2003 entanglement-breaking theorem; it does not derive quantum mechanics. v15.95 holonomy is a one-axis tangent at fixed support, not Einstein. Branches v15.56–v15.74 are not adopted here. scientific_breakthrough: false.

Retained records can support a curvature-like operator (v15.45, main). Ordinary state perturbation cannot move the exterior world if A_G is frozen. The retained description O does not uniquely fix a deeper realization τ (v15.46–53, #57). v15.54 asks whether that gap survives a frozen classical comparator; independent verifier GREEN is necessary but not the final certificate. v15.55 ran on its research branch. RESULTS.json says RESPONSE_NONUNIQUE: seven coefficients, branch-swap rank 3, composition and naturality add no further rank, four degrees of freedom survive. The next missing object is a first-principles selector or a richer defect structure. That is not a unique source. v16.36 does not supply one. A unit barrier bound does not either, and it also does not prove that the retained structure cannot contribute.
